name: Los Barrios (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Barrios (a brown tower with a key on yellow).
history: The modified arms, the flag, the logo and the anthem of the municipality were approved officially and entered in the Registro Andaluz de Entidades Locales on 28 May 2013 (Boletín Oficial de la Junta de Andalucía no. 114 of 13 June 2013); the flag is rectangular with two horizontal stripes, yellow above and green below, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Los Barrios arms — tower with a key on yellow
